sentences.text: Weill Cornell Medicine -LSB- waɪl_kɔrˈnɛl -RSB- is the biomedical research unit and medical school of Cornell University , a private Ivy League university .	Cornell University	Cornell University	biomedical research	biomedical research	medical school	medical school	private	private university	Ivy League	Ivy League	university	university

The medical college is located at 1300 York Avenue , on the Upper East Side of Manhattan in New York City , along with the Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences .	New York City	New York City	New York	New York (state)	York Avenue	York Avenue	Upper East Side	Upper East Side	Manhattan	Manhattan	Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences	Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences

One of the most selective medical schools in the United States -LRB- based on analysis by U.S. News & World Report -RRB- , Cornell enrolls approximately 100 students per class .	U.S. News & World Report	U.S. News & World Report
In 2015 , 6,183 persons applied , and 800 were interviewed for only 106 seats .
The average undergraduate GPA and MCAT scores for successful applicants were 3.84 and 36 , respectively .	GPA	GPA	MCAT	MCAT
The college is named after benefactor and former Citigroup chairman Sanford Weill .	Citigroup	Citigroup	Sanford Weill	Sanford Weill
